title: Mummy and Multi-Faced Sorcerer
description: A tall, pale multi-faced man in a black coat stands with arms outstretched, glowing purple orbs floating near his hands containing alien symbols and figures. In front, a bandaged mummy warrior with purple armor and two alien-emblazoned shields strides forward from a lavender field with mountains behind, all enclosed in a detailed circular frame.
prompt: A surreal fantasy scene featuring a tall pale man with four faces wearing a long black coat, standing with arms outstretched as glowing purple magical orbs float beside him containing alien symbols and small figures. In the foreground, a bandaged mummy warrior in purple armor and two large shields decorated with alien heads walks forward. The background shows a vast lavender flower field with distant mountains, all contained within an intricate circular geometric frame with decorative patterns.
